message:
Log ingestion for the last day is far above normal. Baseline when this was set (RC1-451): about 265 events a day, 1,231 at the busiest in 30 days.

The `main` index is capped at 20,000 indexed logs a day, so the bill is bounded either way — but the cap **drops logs silently** once it is hit, and losing the logs you wanted is a worse outcome than paying for them. This fires at half the cap so there is room to react.

Ingestion is billed even when a log is never indexed. Cutting volume at the index with an exclusion filter saves the indexing cost, not the ingestion cost; to save both, stop sending it. RC1-451. @webhook-incident-summarizer
name: Indexed log volume — daily ingest guardrail
